paragraphs: 📆 Build in : February 2025. 🖥 Type : ReactJS / React Three Fiber / ThreeJS webGL 3D web project.
✨ Context : Made for ThreeJS Journey Challenge February 2025

This project is a Tamagotchi configurator where you can customize your virtual pet by selecting different themes and interacting with buttons to trigger cute animations! 🥚✨ Built with React Three Fiber, it leverages Three.js to bring the Tamagotchi to life inside a ReactJS framework. To optimize loading and manage themes and textures efficiently, I used Zustand for state management. The 3D model was entirely created in Blender 3D, while all textures and characters were hand-drawn and painted by me in Adobe Photoshop. The adorable animations of the creatures were also animated by me in Adobe…
